name: poly-fanout
description: Layer: fan saved chord extras out at the real melodic pair call site 0x080217F4. Stock call: r0=0, r1=start time, r2=duration, r3=voice routing byte, stack [0]=note,[4]=vel,[8]=selector. Cave pushes all regs, reserves a private 16-byte outgoing arg frame, verifies the primary note is present in poly[track][step] (track<3, step<128, count<=8), emits each extra with fresh stock args, then tail-branches to 0x08019A92 so the primary keeps its return value and stock stack side effects. Extras use stock time/duration/routing.

patches.note: real pair call -> chord fan-out cave
